interactables.text: The [Police Officer] guards the door with the weary dignity of a man who trained for hostage negotiations and got [missing poultry] instead. 'Lockdown since [8:15 PM]. Nobody in or out. Not even you, cat.'

The [Manager] paces the rug, shouting into his phone: 'A missing parrot?! Do you know what this does to her brand?! It's a [PR Disaster]!' He steps over you without looking down. You memorize his face.
The Officer's radio crackles on the sideboard: 'Lockdown initiated. [8:15 PM]. No one in or out.' The bird went quiet at eight. The doors locked at eight-fifteen. Interesting gap.
A formal sign-in book by the entrance. Everyone logged their arrival. One entry stands out: '[D. Marsh] — [6:30 PM].' Half an hour before he officially signed in his cases.

localDeductionSentence: The [Police Lockdown] sealed the mansion at 8:15 PM — the Manager only fears a [PR Disaster], but the [Guest Registry] shows one crew member arrived half an hour early.
